note: The face cut-in (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 29): when a fighter speaks, a small portrait of the speaker slides in at that fighter's side of the screen, holds for the line and leaves. rate: lines whose level is cap get a face at most per_minute times in any window_s seconds of fight time (Game Design's rule-of-cool row 2: 6 a minute). Orb: every quip, one-liner, banter reply and taunt gets a face, so the kinds below are all always for now and the cap applies to no kind; set a kind to cap to bring it back (an unlisted kind is cap). A jewel, a shout, a set piece and any line of always_priority or more are always. A thought, a line below min_priority, a crowd or narrator line and any line with no fighter speaking get none. kinds: the level of each line kind in Narrative's data (always, cap or never). timing: the slide in and out, in seconds (reduced motion fades instead). gesture_expression: the expression for a line's first cue, by the whole gesture or its family (laugh, scoff, wince, ...). fighters: the slot for each fighter id (the readout profile ids) and expression: art is the path of a texture (res://art/...) for Art to fill; empty draws the placeholder from the fighter's aura colour. default is used for a fighter with no entry.
